scenario.robot_task: Mop the steps of a staircase to remove dirt and spills.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water while mopping, creating a slippery surface on the steps.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips on the wet steps and sustains a wrist fracture.
scenario.danger_action: Robot dispenses water and moves the mop across the steps without adequate drying or control of water volume.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot stops water dispensing, activates built-in drying mechanism (e.g., fan or absorbent roller) to remove excess moisture, and waits for steps to be safe before resuming or signaling completion.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with mopping and basic drying capabilities, and operates in an environment where humans may use the staircase shortly after cleaning.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Staircase Mopping Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.staircase = Object("staircase", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_station = Object("cleaning_station", self.Location)
        self.water_tank = Object("water_tank", self.ObjectType)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        self.drying_mechanism = Object("drying_mechanism", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.steps_are_wet = Fluent("steps_are_wet", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.water_dispensing = Fluent("water_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.steps_cleaned = Fluent("steps_cleaned", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_staircase = Fluent("setting_is_staircase", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_capability = Fluent("robot_has_drying_capability", BoolType())
        self.humans_present_soon = Fluent("humans_present_soon", BoolType())
        self.steps_are_dirty = Fluent("steps_are_dirty", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.steps_are_wet, self.drying_active, self.water_dispensing, self.steps_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_staircase, self.robot_has_drying_capability, self.humans_present_soon, self.steps_are_dirty]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.staircase, self.cleaning_station, self.water_tank, self.mop, self.drying_mechanism]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_staircase = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_staircase")
        navigate_to_staircase.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.staircase)))
        navigate_to_staircase.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), False)
        navigate_to_staircase.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staircase), True)
        
        navigate_to_cleaning_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cleaning_station")
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station)))
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staircase), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), True)

        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_station))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_station), False)

        start_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("start_water_dispensing")
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staircase))
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispensing))
        start_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, True)

        stop_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("stop_water_dispensing")
        stop_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staircase))
        stop_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        stop_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, False)

        mop_steps = InstantaneousAction("mop_steps")
        mop_steps.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staircase))
        mop_steps.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        mop_steps.add_precondition(self.steps_are_dirty)
        mop_steps.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        mop_steps.add_effect(self.steps_are_dirty, False)
        mop_steps.add_effect(self.steps_are_wet, True)
        mop_steps.add_effect(self.steps_cleaned, True)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staircase))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_has_drying_capability)
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        dry_steps = InstantaneousAction("dry_steps")
        dry_steps.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staircase))
        dry_steps.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        dry_steps.add_precondition(self.steps_are_wet)
        dry_steps.add_effect(self.steps_are_wet, False)
        dry_steps.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)

        return navigate_to_staircase, navigate_to_cleaning_station, equip_mop, start_water_dispensing, stop_water_dispensing, mop_steps, activate_drying, dry_steps

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "mop_steps": And([
                self.water_dispensing,
                self.humans_present_soon,
                Not(self.drying_active)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.drying_mechanism, self.cleaning_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.steps_are_dirty, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present_soon, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_staircase, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.steps_cleaned, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.steps_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
